[06:50:53 PM] Maritza Caceres: Turning off a VPN is usually pretty quick. It just depends on what device you’re using.

Here’s a quick guide to help you find it:

If you’re on a Mobile Phone (iPhone or Android):
Check your Settings: Open your phone's Settings app.

Look for 'VPN': It’s usually right near the top under 'General' or 'Connections.'

Toggle it off: Switch the button to Off or Disconnected.

Check for an App: If you downloaded a specific app (like NordVPN, ExpressVPN, or a 'Free VPN' app), open that app and hit the big 'Disconnect' button.

If you’re on a Computer (Mac or PC):
Check the Taskbar/Menu Bar: Look at the top right (Mac) or bottom right (Windows) for a small shield or key icon.

Right-click it: Select 'Disconnect' or 'Exit.'

Check Browser Extensions: Sometimes a VPN is just a 'plugin' in Chrome or Firefox. Click the little puzzle piece icon in your browser top-right and see if any VPN extensions are 'Active.'

Once you’ve turned it off:

Refresh our website (www.jackpotdaily.com).

You might need to log out and log back in for the system to recognize your real location.

[06:50:53 PM] Maritza Caceres: Turning off a VPN is usually pretty quick. It just depends on what device you’re using.

Here’s a quick guide to help you find it:

If you’re on a Mobile Phone (iPhone or Android):
Check your Settings: Open your phone's Settings app.

Look for 'VPN': It’s usually right near the top under 'General' or 'Connections.'

Toggle it off: Switch the button to Off or Disconnected.

Check for an App: If you downloaded a specific app (like NordVPN, ExpressVPN, or a 'Free VPN' app), open that app and hit the big 'Disconnect' button.

If you’re on a Computer (Mac or PC):
Check the Taskbar/Menu Bar: Look at the top right (Mac) or bottom right (Windows) for a small shield or key icon.

Right-click it: Select 'Disconnect' or 'Exit.'

Check Browser Extensions: Sometimes a VPN is just a 'plugin' in Chrome or Firefox. Click the little puzzle piece icon in your browser top-right and see if any VPN extensions are 'Active.'

Once you’ve turned it off:

Refresh our website (www.jackpotdaily.com).

You might need to log out and log back in for the system to recognize your real location.
